messages:
rita: Scheduling an eviction-protection hedge dry-run Thu 02:00-03:30 UTC. Goal: validate soft-preempt throttles and tenant protection labels under simulated node preemption. No live routing changes. TL;DR: enable test-flag, run synthetic tenant spike, verify eviction metrics + SLO tagging.

omar: Quick ask: will this touch autoscaler settings?

jia: Minor autoscaler override needed so protected tenants don't scale-down during test. I'll bump min_instances +15% for the protected pool at 01:30 and revert at 03:45.

rita: Plan: 01:40 preflight (prewarm KV + label tenants: protected/test), 02:00 enable flag on 3 canary hosts, 02:10 start synthetic spike targeting protected and unprotected tenants, 02:40 trigger soft-preempt (throttle unprotected at 100rps), 03:00 observe fallback, 03:30 cooldown + postmortem. Rollback: immediate flag-off on any p99 > 320ms for 5m or error rate >0.8% for 3m.

sre-bot: Maintenance scheduled: eviction-protection-hedge-dryrun by rita on 2813456789 (Thu 02:00-03:30 UTC). Notified: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product.

omar: Observability checklist: - tag metrics with .eviction-hedge - synthetic probes from us-east/us-west/eu - trace sampling 100% for protected tenants for first 20m - create 'eviction-evicted-count' panel and alert if >0 for protected tenants.

jia: Proxy flag snippet: if header(x-tenant-protection)=="protected" and flag(eviction-hedge)=true -> set throttle_mode="protect" else normal. Will open PR for flag rollout.

deploy-bot: Reminder 60m: eviction-protection-hedge-dryrun starts in 60 minutes.

rita: Loadtest quick command for volunteers:
./tools/loadtest --tag eviction-hedge --duration 20m --qps 500 --header "x-tenant-protection: protected"

omar: I'll own observability during the window. @jia please own flag + autoscaler changes. Short updates here only.

jia: PR: https://intranet.redwood/ops/changes/PR-4991 (eviction hedge flag + autoscaler override). Will post when merged.

rita: Ack. Will compile postmortem and customer notes if needed. React to ack. :white_check_mark:
